## `authorization-request-audits list`

Retrieves the list of Authorization Request Audit with pagination (sorting and filtering)

```
epm-cli authorization-request-audits list [flags]
```

API: `GET /v3/AuthorizationRequestAudits` · Response: `AuthorizationRequestAuditListItemModelPagedResponse`

**Filters and parameters**

| Flag | Type | Values | Description |

| `--page-size` | integer |  | The number of records per page, for example 1. Shouldn't exceed 200. |
| `--page` | integer |  | The page number to retrieve from results, for example 1 |
| `--ticket-id` | string |  | `Filter.TicketId` |

| `--reason` | string |  | `Filter.Reason` |
| `--decision-performed-by-user` | string |  | `Filter.DecisionPerformedByUser` |
| `--decision` | string |  | `Filter.Decision` |
| `--time-of-request-dates` | list of date-time |  | Valid date formats for filter - 2020-12-24, 2020-12-24 19:09:47, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562 +00:00 |
| `--time-of-request-selection-mode` | string | `Single`, `Multiple`, `Range` | The selection mode of date criteria e.g single, multiple, range |

| `--start-time-selection-mode` | string | `Single`, `Multiple`, `Range` | The selection mode of date criteria e.g single, multiple, range |
